integrity: The proof gives an infinite-dimensional analytic argument. The accompanying numerical checks are finite diagnostics only. Literature dates derive from first-public arXiv postings.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted analytic Bergman disk and one-step coefficient coupling only. For subcritical exponents the exact best constant is a Jacobi norm without an elementary closed form; no eigenvalue counting law is asserted. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The sharp half-power cutoff for a Bergman coefficient coupling inequality
